claims: Motion animates your actual words, charts and images; nothing is invented, and changing a word or number just updates the video
Dashboards replaces filing a data request or writing database code; charts self-update and every number is traceable
Document maker, slide maker and design tool are now free on every plan
how_to_steps: Motion: attach/describe the report, let Claude build the animated explainer, edit words/numbers, download as video
Dashboards: connect a data source, ask a question in plain English, pin the resulting chart; click numbers to trace provenance
on_screen_only: Video file 'Claude-Dashboards-Motion-Announcement.mov' playing: 6:55 am city map with routes, presenter 'Nate', '5:50 am' aerial map, 'Tracing every morning ride' bicycle animation
Connector icons: aws, Databricks, Salesforce, Snowflake plus two warehouse-style icons
Dashboard screen 'System overview' with KPI tiles and charts; second dashboard with scatter + bar charts

Comment panel: '@Claude — Send to Claude'; 'All comments: Sam: Can we name the van route here? Ops will ask. / Dev: Love the 4,200. Put it on the all hands title slide too. / Nate: Hold on the empty dock a beat longer so it lands.'
Export menu with Adobe, Figma/Canva-style, Keynote, Google Slides, Notion, DaVinci-style icons
